evlabrtc_init.tooltip: Initialize the PCF85063 RTC (I2C address 0x51) on the board default I2C bus; no pin selection needed, battery backed

evlabrtc_set_time.message0: [Set time] clock %1 year %2 month %3 day %4 hour %5 min %6 sec %7

evlabrtc_set_compile_time.tooltip: Set the clock to the firmware compile time (flash once to calibrate, then it runs on the backup battery)

evlabrtc_read.tooltip: Read the current time once, then fetch it with the get/format blocks

evlabrtc_format.tooltip: Return a string: date+time / date / time (call "Read once" first)

evlabrtc_lost_power.tooltip: Oscillator stopped (power lost without backup) => time is unreliable, set it again

evlabrtc_present.tooltip: Probe over I2C whether the RTC responds (0x51)
